newsitem.title: USA: Sequoia sees Q1 sales below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Sequoia sees Q1 sales below expectations.

text.p: Sequoia Systems Inc said on Thursday that it expects its consolidated revenues to be below expectations for the first quarter ended September 29, 1996.
The company's first quarter net loss will be in line with expectations, Sequoia said.
In last year's first quarter, the company reported a profit of $0.11 a share on sales of $27.5 million.
Sequoia acting chief financial officer Randy Sumrall expects the company's loss to be an improvement from last quarter's loss of $0.15 a share and sales should be below last quarter's $23.7 million.
